newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere shareholders to meet June 30.
newsitem.headline: Solidere shareholders to meet June 30.

text.p: The board of Lebanon's Solidere on Tuesday rescheduled for June 30 its ordinary and extraordinary shareholders assemblies, the company said in a statement.
"The ordinary and the extraordinary sessions were not held today because they both lacked legal quorum," the statement said.
The extraordinary assembly requires 66 percent quorum while the ordinary one requires 50 percent.
Shareholders at the extraordinary session were due to vote on Tuesday on cancelling company shares worth about $170 million.
They were also due to approve at the ordinary session a 25 cents dividend for 1996 -- 25 percent up on the 1995 dividend.
